versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Provides a structured workflow for adapting SkillScan-style productivity and security patterns.
- Supports users seeking help with bug fixing, setup hardening, workflow reliability, and related tasks.
- Delivers concise plans, templates, checklists, automations, and implementation support.
- Focuses on outputs that are local-hardware friendly and tailored to immediate user needs.
- Includes built-in validation steps and guidance for next actions.
